quests.question: This agreement shall remain in effect ___ either party provides written notice of termination.
quests.hint: The agreement stays active right up to an uncertain future action.
quests.explanation: 'Until' shows the agreement remaining valid up to whenever a termination notice is given.

quests.question: The tenant shall be held responsible ___ any damages beyond normal wear and tear.
quests.hint: This links accountability to the specific harm caused.
quests.explanation: 'Responsible for' names the specific harm someone is accountable for, here damages.

quests.question: All disputes arising ___ this contract shall be resolved through arbitration.
quests.hint: This links a dispute back to the document that caused it.
quests.explanation: 'Arising from' is the fixed legal idiom linking a dispute to the document or situation that caused it.

quests.question: This study builds ___ previous research conducted in the field of cognitive psychology.
quests.hint: This links extending existing work to the foundation it started from.
quests.explanation: 'Build on' is the fixed academic idiom for extending or developing existing research.

quests.question: The findings are consistent ___ earlier studies on the same topic.
quests.hint: This links agreement between two sets of results.
quests.explanation: 'Consistent with' is the fixed idiom for showing agreement between two sets of findings.

quests.question: The methodology employed differs significantly ___ that used in prior research.
quests.hint: This introduces the specific thing being compared against, as taught earlier in this course.
quests.explanation: 'Differs from' returns here, introducing the methodology being compared against.

quests.question: The scandal, which came ___ light last week, has already claimed two high-profile resignations.
quests.hint: This is a fixed idiom meaning something became publicly known.
quests.explanation: 'Came to light' is a fixed idiom meaning something previously hidden became publicly known.

quests.question: The minister announced her resignation this morning, ___ mounting public pressure.
quests.hint: This describes an announcement made within an overall atmosphere of pressure.
quests.explanation: 'Amid' describes an event unfolding within an overall abstract atmosphere, here mounting pressure.

quests.question: The company's shares plummeted ___ the wake of the scandal.
quests.hint: This is the fixed word that always begins the phrase describing an aftermath.
quests.explanation: 'In the wake of' is the fixed multiword phrase; 'in' is the word that always begins it.

quests.question: If the issue persists, please refer ___ the troubleshooting guide on page twelve.
quests.hint: This links checking something to the resource being consulted.
quests.explanation: 'Refer to' is the fixed idiom for directing someone to consult a resource.

quests.question: The software is compatible ___ most major operating systems.
quests.hint: This links one system's ability to work alongside another.
quests.explanation: 'Compatible with' is the fixed idiom for describing systems that work well together.

quests.question: Access to the database will be restricted ___ authorized personnel only.
quests.hint: This links a limitation to the specific group still permitted access.
quests.explanation: 'Restricted to' is the fixed idiom for limiting access to a specific group.

quests.question: Patients should be screened ___ any known allergies prior to treatment.
quests.hint: This links a medical check to the specific condition being looked for.
quests.explanation: 'Screened for' is the fixed medical idiom for checking someone for a specific condition.

quests.question: Recovery times vary considerably ___ patient to patient.
quests.hint: This is the fixed word that begins the phrase describing a range across individual cases.
quests.explanation: 'Vary from patient to patient' is the fixed idiom for describing a range that differs across individual cases.

quests.question: The treatment plan will be adjusted ___ the patient's response over the coming weeks.
quests.hint: This links a future adjustment to the evidence that will guide it.
quests.explanation: 'According to' introduces the evidence or source that will guide a future decision, here the patient's response.

quests.question: Your performance this quarter has exceeded expectations ___ every measurable category.
quests.hint: This names the areas where performance is being measured.
quests.explanation: 'Exceeded expectations in' names the specific categories where performance was measured.

quests.question: We'd like to discuss your progress ___ the goals set during your last review.
quests.hint: This links advancement to the target it's moving in the direction of.
quests.explanation: 'Progress toward' is the standard formal idiom for describing advancement toward a target.

quests.question: Following this conversation, a formal warning will be issued ___ continued underperformance.
quests.hint: This introduces a possible future condition, meaning 'if this happens'.
quests.explanation: 'In the event of' is a formal multiword preposition meaning 'if this situation occurs', common in HR and legal writing.

quests.question: The property is situated ___ walking distance of several excellent schools.
quests.hint: This emphasizes being inside a convenient boundary of distance.
quests.explanation: 'Within' emphasizes being inside a convenient boundary, here a walkable distance to schools.

quests.question: The listing price reflects recent sale prices ___ comparable properties in the neighborhood.
quests.hint: This links a set of prices to the properties they belong to.
quests.explanation: 'Sale prices of' links a set of figures to the specific properties they describe.

quests.question: Renovations must be completed ___ the terms outlined in the purchase agreement.
quests.hint: This shows an action following the rules set out in a formal document, as taught earlier in this course.
quests.explanation: 'In accordance with' shows compliance with a stated set of terms, the same idiom taught earlier for company policy.

quests.question: Returns on this fund have consistently outperformed the market ___ the past five years.
quests.hint: This describes a trend across a recent stretch of time, as taught earlier in this course.
quests.explanation: 'Over' fits a trend across a recent period, the same pattern taught earlier for describing performance across time.

quests.question: The merger is expected to result ___ significant cost savings for both companies.
quests.hint: The cause comes first here, followed by its effect, as taught earlier in this course.
quests.explanation: 'Result in' shows a cause leading to an effect, the same pattern taught earlier in this course.

quests.question: The fund managed to post modest gains, ___ the recent downturn.
quests.hint: This shows a positive outcome achieved even though an obstacle occurred.
quests.explanation: 'In spite of' shows an outcome achieved despite an obstacle; 'despite of' remains a common but incorrect blended form.
quests.grammarRule: Contrast: despite vs in spite of

quests.question: The new legislation was passed ___ overwhelming bipartisan support.
quests.hint: This links a decision to the level of backing it received.
quests.explanation: 'Passed with support' is the fixed idiom describing the level of backing a decision received.

quests.question: Businesses must now report emissions data quarterly, ___ the new regulations.
quests.hint: This shows a requirement following the rules of a formal regulation, as taught earlier in this course.
quests.explanation: 'In accordance with' fits again, showing a requirement that follows a formal set of rules.

quests.question: The proposal has sparked fierce debate ___ lawmakers on both sides of the aisle.
quests.hint: This is a countable group of many individual people, not exactly two or a general atmosphere.
quests.explanation: 'Among' fits a countable group of individuals, here lawmakers, rather than exactly two people or an abstract atmosphere.

quests.question: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction ___ the service I received last week.
quests.hint: This links a negative feeling to the specific experience that caused it.
quests.explanation: 'Dissatisfaction with' is the fixed idiom for expressing a negative feeling about a specific experience.

quests.question: Despite multiple attempts to resolve this matter, I have yet to receive a response ___ your team.
quests.hint: This links an expected reply to the people who should have sent it.
quests.explanation: 'Response from' is the fixed idiom naming the source an expected reply should come from.

quests.question: I trust this matter will be addressed ___ the urgency it deserves.
quests.hint: This links how an action should be carried out to the manner or attitude behind it.
quests.explanation: 'Addressed with urgency' shows the manner in which an action should be carried out, closing this unit on a formal, assertive note.
